CustomObject.description:
Identifies a freshly-started Agentforce chat conversation with the Skywave anonymous deviceId. Published by Skywave_SessionIdentify (Sites guest user) when the consumer site's onEmbeddedMessagingConversationStarted handler fires. A trigger on this event runs in System Mode and stamps MessagingSession.Session_ID__c on the row whose ConversationId matches.
Decoupled from MessagingSession DML so the publisher (anonymous Sites guest) doesn't need MessagingSession edit permission, which is gated by Service Cloud licensing.
CustomObject.label: Skywave Identify Session
